currentRepositoryRule: The license published by the owning repository or artifact record controls. No organization-wide grant may be inferred, and existing work is not relicensed without a rights and contributor audit.

defaultsForNewWork.selectionRule: Use MIT by default. Apache-2.0 may be selected when an explicit patent grant is materially useful.
Use CC BY 4.0 for papers and general documentation unless upstream material requires compatible additional terms.
Use CERN-OHL-S-2.0 for new hardware design sources after confirming the artifact is within its intended scope.
Select per dataset after provenance, consent, privacy, and upstream-license review.
Select per model, weight, or checkpoint after training-data, upstream-model, and distribution-term review.
Use a dedicated brand-asset permission policy. Copyright permission and trademark or endorsement rules must remain separate.

memberProjects.statement: Joining Elixpo or transferring a repository does not silently relicense a Member Project or its contributor work.

existingRepositories.statement: Existing custom, missing, or mixed licenses remain in force until project authority and contributor permissions are established.

trademarks.statement: Copyright licenses do not grant a right to impersonate Elixpo, claim endorsement, or control official names, domains, registry identities, or distribution accounts.

openSourceClaims.statement: An artifact with field-of-use, competitor, royalty, or similar restrictions must not be described as open source merely because another artifact in the repository uses an open-source license.
